address: 5F, The Henderson, 2 Murray Road, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Chef Akira Back’s debut concept in the city unveils a menu that feels bold and familiar at the same time. His creative flair draws upon his Korean heritage, finessed by Japanese nuances and modern American twists. The generous dishes, designed to be shared, make the venue ideal for friendly get-togethers and casual dinner parties. His artist mother’s work is everywhere – on paintings, murals and tableware....
